DriverNotes.Text: The camera vehicle was travelling faster than it did for most of the video.
Other traffic was moving faster than the camera vehicle.
The camera vehicle was closing on the vehicle ahead quickly (as little as 1.0 s from contact) before the final moment — following too closely for the speed.
No braking was seen before the impact, although the hazard was in the camera vehicle's path for 3.6 s. That points to inattention or distraction.
The camera doesn't show the inside of the cab, so phone use or other distraction can only be judged from how the vehicle moved.

DriverIssues: no braking with the hazard in view for 3.6 s (possible distraction)
Narrative: At 0:03.6 the video shows a rear-end collision, ahead, at the right edge of the camera vehicle's lane, at the front of the camera vehicle. Involved: the camera vehicle, V1 (white car), V2 (gray car). 60 other road users were in view but not involved. Most of the fault lies with the camera vehicle (100%). The camera vehicle's driving contributed: no braking with the hazard in view for 3.6 s (possible distraction); following too closely.
